newsitem.title: USA: Stone Container sets debenture offering.
newsitem.headline: Stone Container sets debenture offering.

text.p: Stone Container Corp said Tuesday it is offering $250.0 million aggregate principal amount of debenture units.

The units each consist of one Series B 10-3/4 percent senior subordinated debenture due 2002 and one related supplemental interest certificate, representing an additional amount of interest to be paid.
The offering will be used to refinance $150 million principal amount of 10-3/4 senior subordinated notes due June 15, 1997, and the balance will be used to fund capital expenditures, Stone said.
The interest certificate is not detachable from the debenture. The amount of additional interest will be determined at pricing, it added.

The offering is part of a $700 million funding program announced earlier today. Stone said the $700 million funding plan will meet its financing and debt amortization needs and restore appropriate liquidity.
The offering is being underwritten by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities and BT Securities.
Stone said the offering is expected to begin later this week.
